mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5% in 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) and low monetary policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a 'stagflation' risk, where the central bank is constrained from easing further, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary regime characterized by rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve typically implements aggressive monetary easing, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS MoM growth exceeds 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 95.0 for 2 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by high housing starts), a decline in housing permits (HOUST) below 650.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, when HOUST < 650.0, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above $400 billion signals strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS exceeds $400 billion for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.
